interaction_review.current_record: The independent iodine and thyroid-medicine pages provide general context but do not clear the declared brown-algae iodine product for an individual thyroid condition or medication list.
topics_requiring_separate_review: existing thyroid disease and thyroid laboratory context
brown-algae source variability and iodine standardization
additional iodine, seaweed and fortified-food intake

safety_review.current_record: No manufacturer warning topics are listed. This is an absence of declared warnings, not an independent safety clearance.
topics_requiring_separate_review: brown-algae identity, contaminants and batch variability
duplicate intake and total exposure context
source recency and current product formulation

interpretation_limits: General iodine guidance and levothyroxine information are not product-specific interaction evidence.
No efficacy, individual suitability, interaction clearance, dose approval or patient-facing publication was performed.
All listed interaction topics remain questions for independent verification, not established product findings.
